title: F_TRIG: falling edge detection
summary: F_TRIG sets Q for exactly one call when CLK changes from TRUE to FALSE.

sections.heading: Behavior
sections.body: **Q** is TRUE only in the call where **CLK** is FALSE and was TRUE in the previous call. It is used to react to a button release or a sensor becoming free.

sections.heading: Startup behavior
sections.body: In PLC Lab's generic profile the remembered value starts FALSE, so F_TRIG never reports an edge in the first scan. This is a documented choice of the generic profile.

outputs.name: Q
outputs.description: TRUE for one call on a TRUE-to-FALSE change

instruction.timing: Edge is relative to the previous call.
